rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a group or lot of similar things.

example.english: This batch of documents has to be mailed today.
example.traditional: 呢一批文件要今日寄出。
example.jyutping: ni1 jat1 pai1 man4 gin6 jiu3 gam1 jat6 gei3 ceot1

rows.note: Use this for baked goods made in one oven round, such as 一爐曲奇.

example.english: This batch of cookies is out of the oven.
example.jyutping: ni1 jat1 lou4 kuk1 kei4 ceot1 lou4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the batch specifically means the class graduating in a given year.

example.english: Our graduating batch is going back to school next month to take graduation photos.
example.traditional: 我哋畢業班下個月返學校影畢業相。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jip6 baan1 haa6 go3 jyut6 faan1 hok6 haau6 jing2 bat1 jip6 soeng2

rows.note: Use this for a graduating cohort identified by its school year or generation, as in 嗰屆學生.

example.english: I was a student in the 2018 batch.
example.traditional: 我係二零一八年嗰一屆嘅學生。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 ji6 ling4 jat1 baat3 nin4 go2 jat1 gaai3 ge3 hok6 saang1
